name: io.github.borgels/mcp-server-fatsecret
title: FatSecret
description: MCP server for the FatSecret Platform API: food diary, weight, exercise and food search.

environmentVariables.name: FATSECRET_CONSUMER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 1.0a consumer key of the FatSecret Platform app.

environmentVariables.name: FATSECRET_CONSUMER_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 1.0a shared secret of the FatSecret Platform app.

environmentVariables.name: FATSECRET_OAUTH2_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 client id for food and recipe search. Defaults to the consumer key.

environmentVariables.name: FATSECRET_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret. Defaults to the consumer secret.

environmentVariables.name: FATSECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Key that encrypts stored per-user tokens (at least 16 characters).

environmentVariables.name: FATSECRET_STORE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path of the encrypted token store.

environmentVariables.name: FATSECRET_DEV_USER
environmentVariables.description: Identity used for per-user tools over stdio.

environmentVariables.name: FATSECRET_PREMIER
environmentVariables.description: Set to true only if the FatSecret Platform app is on the Premier tier.
